description_en: Introduces the syntax and examples of the RecognizePublicFace operation for public figure recognition
description_zh: 本文介绍公众人物识别RecognizePublicFace的语法及示例
name: RecognizePublicFace

element_fields.help_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in OSS links outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

> The system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal addresses before downloading files, so calling this API does not incur OSS traffic fees
element_fields.help_zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即最多同时对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

> 对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费
element_fields.name: image_url

element_fields.help_en:
The Base64-encoded string of the image. When both this parameter and the URL parameter are specified, the URL parameter takes precedence.
For information about Base64 encoding of files, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
element_fields.help_zh:
图像Base64编码字符串。当与URL方式共存时，URL方式优先。
文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
element_fields.name: image_data
